definition: the speaker and the hearer lack a permission their work needs
expansion: (situation lack-permission (HOLDER (term INCLUSIVE-COLLECTIVE READING-OF-A-COLLECTIVE.JOINT)) (CONTENT (situation work (ACTOR (term INCLUSIVE-COLLECTIVE READING-OF-A-COLLECTIVE.JOINT)))))
pragmatic conditions: when shared work reaches a step neither participant is permitted to take
constructed history: Constructed history: a permission was a door that opened to its holder, and finding the door shut warned that a permission was lacking.
